title: PRE-RAID: QUIETER WARNING, ONE GUN CHIP, TALLER PACK ROWS AND BIGGER STEPPERS, SOFTER MAP LABELS
why: The critic scored the shipped design A page 3 and named: a dead gap in the kit column, two confusing gun chips, an amber warning bar as loud as the ascend plate, loud outlined map labels with cramped keyed room tags, small steppers and a stray saves as you go line. Rows grow to 46 px, steppers to 36 px, the warning loses its fill, the gun chips merge, the keyed room names sit beside their rooms, and the panel double frame goes.
now: The pre-raid page is calmer: one gun line, a quiet no armour row, taller pack rows with bigger plus and minus buttons, and softer map labels.
